content: Lilobhe kwa bhando bhu ku Epecho

“Munyandikile yenio ntumiche jwa lilongo lya bhando lilinnyeketii Kilichitu lya ku Epecho kubhehe.” “Ghongo ndi nhwalo gwa jwenio jwangamulila ndondwa chaba mu lubhoko lwango lwalelo na kutyanga panakate jha inala chaba itengenichwe ya chaabo yukubheke kolobohi.

Nighamanye matendwa ghino, manye kughagha kwino na kuhimbilila kwino. Manye mihoto jhe kuhimbilila bhando bhanganandela na kwajhigha bhibhakikema akatenga kongo akatenga jhe na mawene kubhehe akawange.
Mwenga muhimbilila na milagha kwa nhwalo jha kundumikii nenga, hilu mikahengelike jhe mwojho.
Nambo kibhii kilebhe chimo chakunobholela, ngohe, mwenga umbahii jhe ngita hela makacho.

Nkombokela pala pumakalemwite, muuleke uhakaho na kughalambuka na mukahenge ngita chinteila makacho. Anda nakuleka jhe gwanganandela gwino nihika kwino kukibhoha kinala chino chukubheke kolobohi kubhoka pikikibha.
Nambo ninnumba kilebhe chimo, mwenga maghachimwa ghibhatenda Akanikolai ngita nenga chinighachimwa.

“Jwabhii na machikilo gha kujhoha, abangatuka kwa ghala Uhuke aghalonge malongo gha bhando ghighannyeketii Kilichitu! “Jwapalakuotola naninekekeya alye uhohe kubhoka mu nkongo gwa Chapanga gwa ughome ghubhii ku pepo.”
Lilobhe kwa bhando bhu ku Chimilina

“Munyandikile yenio kwa ntumiche jwa kunane kwa Chapanga kwa lilongo lya bhando lilinnyeketii Kilichitu lya ku Chimilina.” “Lilobhe lende lyalongila ndi jwakutumbula na kujhomolela, ngawila na ngohe abhii ghome,

nu kumanye kulagha kwino na manye hele nhocho gwino, nambo chakaka mwenga mmii na ilebhe mbwe! Manye chibhanigha bhala bhibhakikema Akayahude nambo Akayahude bha chakaka ndeka, nambo bheniya lilongo lya Limbembela.

Mangapwelela jhe kwa ghala ghighapala kunkolela. Jhokanikiya, Limbembela apakunnyigha kwa kummeka mu kipungo, kabhele mangota mipala kulagha kwa machiko kome. Nambo mangotamwe nhobholeka ade kuwegha, nane nanimpela ndweko jha ughome.”
“Jwabhii na machikilo gha kujhoha, abangatuka kwa ghala Uhuke aghalongele malongo gha bhando ghighanyeketii Kilichitu! “Jwapala kuhotola nakongana ng'o na kuwe kwa mala jha ubhele.”
Lilobhe kwa bhando bhu ku Paligamo
“Jhandika yenio ntumiche jwa lilongo lya bhando lilinnyeketii Kilichitu lya ku Peligamo.” “Lilobhe lende ndi lihumii kwa jwenio jwabhii na upanga ghutema kone na kone.

Nu kumanye kumita: Mitama pahina na kigoda chakinahota cha Limbembela! Nambo mukajhendilii kuhobholeka mu liina lyango, nambo nkanita jhe kuhobholela, ata mu machiko gha Antipa ntumiche jwango jwahobholeka kwa nenga jwakomitwa pamuche gwino, peniya, patama Limbembela.

Nambo mmii na malobhe ghandina gha kunobholela, bhange pakate jhino bhakengama mabholo gha Balaamo, jwenio akammolita Balake kwalongocha bhando bhu ku Ichilahele bhajhingii muhakaho kwa kulyegha yakulya itambikilwe kwa inyagho na bhatenda ngongola.
Helahela bhabhii bhange pakate jhino bhibhakengama mabholo gha Akanikolai.
Nng'alambuke na kuuleka uhakaho. Anda nakuleka jhe, nihika kwino kajhombe kukomana na bhando bheniya kwa upanga ghuhuma mu nnomo gwango.

“Jwabhii na machikilo gha kujhoha, abangatuka kwa ghala Uhuke aghalobholela malongo gha bhando ghighannyeketii Kilichitu! “Jwapakuhotola chanimpela chakulya chikiitwe chikikemwa mana. Nanimpela lighanga liuu lya mbuu lilijhandikwe liina liyono na abhii jhe mundo jwalimanye, nambo jwajho tu jwalipokela lighanga lyenio.
Lilobhe kwa bhando bhu ku Tiyatila

“Munyandikile yenio ntumiche jwa lilongo lya bhando lilinnyeketii Kilichitu lya ku Tiyatila.” “Lende ndi lilobhe lya Mwana jwa Chapanga, jwabhii na miho ghighajhaka ngita lulime lwa mwotu na jhuna magholo ghighang'ala ngita shaba jhikeitwe:
Niimanye itendwa hino. Manye mapalo ghino na manye kihobholelo chino. Manye utumiche gwino na manye kuhimbilila kwino. Ngohe mihenga kuchocha kuliku pala pitumbwila.

Nambo ngwete kilebhe chimo chakunkelebhuya, mwenga munhimbilila jhola mwikeghe Yechebule jwakikema jwenio nnondole jwa Chapanga. Jwabhola na kwakoloya bhando bhango bhatende ngongola na kulye yakulya itambikilwe kwa inyagho.
Nenga nimpile kipinde chu kughalambuka na kuleka ungongola gwake, nambo akanite kuileka ngongola yake.
Ngohe, na nimpela ulwalo tolatola, jwenio pamonga na ajhake bhibhatei ngongola pamonga na nabhalagha hake, anda nakughalambuka jhe na kuileka itendwa yabhe yanganandela.

Nambo nanakoma bhala bhibhankengama, kupala lilongo lyoha lya bhando lilinnyeketii Kilichitu bhamanye kubhehe nenga ndi jhunilingukiya ghighabhii umyojho na malango gha bhando. Na ninepa kila mundo tela na chatehila.”

“Nambo mangota bhange mitamangana ku muche ghu ku Tiyatila bhutamita chakakengama mabholo ghake Yechebule, na mikibholite jhe chela chikikemita ‘Chile jha Limbembela,’ ninobholela na ne nanigheleka jhe nhigho ghonge panane jhino.
Nambo mughakamulii ghala ghuminako ngohe ade pambakuhika.
Jwapakuhotola nu kujhendele kukamuu ilebhe iniipala, nanimpela ukindendeke gwa kwalongocha bhando bha ilambo henge.
Nabhalongocha kwa nkongocho gwa choma na kwakajhulana ngita yombo ya undope.
Nahenga kwa ukindendeke ghoghola ghola ngita nenga chimbokile kuhumii kwa Tate gwango, na kabhele nanimpela lundondwa lwa lukela jwa pakuhotola.
“Jwabhii na machikilo gha kujhoha, abangatuka Uhuke aghalongelela malongo gha bhando ghighannyeketii Kilichitu!”
